finding: Four more Stay listings lacked current dated operator checks. The Orchard was incorrectly marked unsourced after a September TLS failure even though its operator site now responds; it also claimed an infrared sauna absent from the current operator description. Hideaways used an old review page, a direct-booking label without a booking URL, unsupported price comparisons and amenity claims. Cassis and The Sanctuary had current operator information but stale review dates.
hypothesis: Recovering the live operator and host sources, removing unsupported comparisons and amenities, and dating the two otherwise sound records will make these four stay decisions more truthful and usable.
boundedChange: Recover The Orchard operator website and booking route, remove unsupported sauna and price positioning, and retain only operator-supported apartment details. Link Hideaways to its current host listing, label Airbnb as provider, and narrow copy to the identified Woodland Cottage. Date source checks for Cassis and The Sanctuary. Preserve negative evidence in this assessment. Replace the three shared fallback hero assets with a sourced Mornington Peninsula vineyard photograph, visibly disclose it as illustrative and link the original and CC BY-SA licence. Reject uncredited or undescribed CMS hero overrides for these three listings so the licensed fallback and its attribution are actually rendered. Apply the same override guard to each detail page social image so metadata matches the visible hero.

The Orchard no longer asserts an infrared sauna or an unsourced state; Hideaways has a functioning host booking route and no unsupported price comparison.

negativeFindings: The Orchard operator URL was recorded as gone after a 2026-09-13 TLS fault; on 2026-10-03 it responded over HTTPS and displayed the apartments. Historical retired-link fields were removed from the current record; the old probe remains in the ledger.
The Orchard operator page does not describe an infrared sauna; that claim was removed.
The current Hideaways host listing supports Woodland Cottage, not every formerly advertised cottage; the page no longer generalises amenities across the business.
Woodman Estate and Happy Glamper require separate service-format and current-inclusion reviews; they remain in the eleven outstanding records.

Independent review found that place-red-hill-01.webp is a vineyard-row photograph, whereas its LICENSES.md citation resolves to a close-up of CSIRO grapes. The file does not match its recorded source, so its rights cannot be verified from that citation. This batch removes the asset from three Stay records; other corpus uses remain a separate image-rights hard gate.
The Hideaways host describes Woodland Cottage as a guest suite attached to the hosts home. Copy implying a standalone private cottage was removed.

The refreshed source ledger no longer assigns the wrong CSIRO file to place-red-hill-01.webp. Thirty remaining next/src files still reference that asset; the sitewide rights and image-subject review remains open.

Rendered build inspection found all three Stay detail pages used CMS hero overrides with no visible credit, hiding the newly sourced fallback. The hero resolver now requires both override alt and credit for these three venues; otherwise it uses the verified fallback.

Independent follow-up review found the Stay detail route still emitted the incomplete CMS image as its social preview despite the guarded visible hero; the route now uses the same scoped resolver option.

A rendered fallback photograph did not show Source/Licence links because the old hasPhoto predicate classifies shared place artwork as a placeholder; link rendering now follows the actually rendered non-CMS hero, not that classification.

A 2026-10-03 source-record recount found five records previously listed as unchecked already carried operator source reviews dated 2026-10-01. The corrected coverage at this releases end is 21 of 27 with attributable source records dated 2026-09-30 or later, leaving six without such a record. This supersedes the inherited 16-of-27 count.
